narrative: Message claiming to be Central Bank Insurance Officer.

message.body: Central Bank Safety Regulation: Your deposit insurance compliance needs renewal. Submit account confirmation at http://deposit-safety-verify.net

evidence.label: Regulatory Claim
evidence.value: Claims RBI requires individual deposit safety verification

evidence.label: RBI Official Advisory Site
evidence.value: RBI advisory explicitly states central bank never contacts individuals for deposit verification.

consequence_text.safe: You checked official RBI advisories and confirmed central banks do not request individual account verification.
consequence_text.unsafe: Submitting data on fake regulator sites compromises financial credentials.

teaching_point: Central banks and financial regulators do not contact individual customers for account renewals.
